newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung confirms plan to merge Japan units.
newsitem.headline: Samsung confirms plan to merge Japan units.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Group confirmed on Thursday a newspaper report that it planned to merge units of two of its member firms in Japan.
But Samsung's spokesman Cho Jang-won said a decision to list the merged firm on the Tokyo Stock Exchange was not yet finalised.
"It is our plan to merge, but we have not yet reached a conclusion on whether to list the merged firm," said Cho.

Japan's Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported on Thursday Samsung planned to merge Samsung Electronics Japan Co and Samsung Japan Co by the end of this year and aimed to list shares of the merged firm on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Samsung Electronics Japan Co is a subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co, South Korea's biggest maker of dynamic random access memory (DRAM) chips.
Samsung Japan Co is a regional headquarters for all Samsung Group affiliates, Cho said.
